commands:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
EXPECTED=3b331791d6ea2a372f42dd4cb3746af26441cd29
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$EXPECTED"
git checkout -B "$BRANCH" "origin/$BRANCH"
git reset --hard "origin/$BRANCH"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/main/emulator_main.c')
s=p.read_text()
repls=[
('    uint16_t zone_status = 0U;','    uint16_t zone_status = EZB_ZCL_IAS_ZONE_ZONE_STATUS_RESTORE_NOTIFY;'),
('    uint16_t ias_zone_status = 0U;','    uint16_t ias_zone_status = EZB_ZCL_IAS_ZONE_ZONE_STATUS_RESTORE_NOTIFY;'),
('            ias_zone_status = ias_zone_status == 0U ?\n                EZB_ZCL_IAS_ZONE_ZONE_STATUS_ALARM1 : 0U;','            ias_zone_status ^= EZB_ZCL_IAS_ZONE_ZONE_STATUS_ALARM1;')
]
for old,new in repls:
    if s.count(old) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one match: {old!r}, got {s.count(old)}')
    s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
git diff --check
python3 tests/host/test_no_embedded_nul.py
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null
cd tests/zigbee_device_emulator
rm -f sdkconfig sdkconfig.old; rm -rf build
idf.py set-target esp32c6 >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('sdkconfig')
s=p.read_text()
old='CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED=y'
new='# CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED is not set\nCONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_IAS_CONTACT=y'
if s.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'mixed profile default count={s.count(old)}')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
idf.py reconfigure >/dev/null
idf.py build >/dev/null
cd ../..
git checkout -- tests/zigbee_device_emulator/dependencies.lock 2>/dev/null || true
git add tests/zigbee_device_emulator/main/emulator_main.c
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Preserve IAS restore notifications'
FIX_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git push --verbose origin HEAD:refs/heads/$BRANCH
echo IAS_RESTORE_NOTIFY_FIX_HEAD=$FIX_HEAD
git status --short
